name: traffic-intel-pp-cli
description: Private combined SEO and traffic intelligence CLI that joins Google Search Console, GA4, and Ahrefs child CLI evidence into local-first page, revenue, and refresh recommendations.

novel_features.name: Unified source sync
novel_features.description: sync imports fixture/local data or shells out to GSC, GA4, and Ahrefs child CLIs and normalizes page metrics into one local store

novel_features.name: Money pages
novel_features.description: money-pages ranks pages by revenue, conversions, sessions, clicks, and Ahrefs link context

novel_features.name: Query revenue
novel_features.description: query-revenue finds matching pages and summarizes revenue evidence for a URL or topic fragment

novel_features.name: Explain drop
novel_features.description: explain-drop combines click, session, revenue, and backlink deltas into a compact root-cause explanation

novel_features.name: Refresh queue
novel_features.description: refresh-queue prioritizes pages to update using lost clicks, revenue risk, and link value

novel_features.name: Opportunity gap
novel_features.description: opportunity-gap ranks high-impression near-ranking pages by expected CTR gap, GA4 business value, and Ahrefs link context

novel_features.name: Quick wins
novel_features.description: quick-wins surfaces near-page-one pages with weak CTR and conversion or revenue value

novel_features.name: Revenue at risk
novel_features.description: revenue-at-risk ranks pages where organic or session declines overlap with commercial value

novel_features.name: Refresh brief
novel_features.description: refresh-brief creates an agent-ready page brief with likely issue, metrics, recommended actions, and follow-up commands

novel_features.name: Cannibalization
novel_features.description: cannibalization groups pages competing for the same query or topic and recommends a canonical URL

novel_features.name: Topic clusters
novel_features.description: topic-clusters summarizes clicks, revenue, backlinks, and decay by inferred topic cluster

novel_features.name: Source coverage
novel_features.description: source-coverage audits which pages have GSC, GA4, and Ahrefs evidence and which source syncs are missing

novel_features.name: Internal link plan
novel_features.description: internal-link-plan recommends source and target pages for internal links using topic clusters, revenue, and link equity

novel_features.name: Experiment plan
novel_features.description: experiment-plan turns one page into title, meta, content, and measurement tests

novel_features.name: Forecast impact
novel_features.description: forecast-impact estimates click, conversion, and revenue upside from closing CTR gaps

novel_features.name: Stale winners
novel_features.description: stale-winners finds high-value pages to refresh before visible decay

novel_features.name: Weekly digest
novel_features.description: digest weekly produces a local-first traffic and revenue summary that handles empty datasets cleanly
